mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.record_no, r.sensor_code, r.batch_id, b.batch_no, r.sample_time, r.longitude, r.latitude, r.db_value, r.spectrum_summary, r.raw_data_hash, r.created_by, r.created_at, CASE WHEN ae.id IS NULL THEN 'NONE' ELSE ae.status END AS anomaly_status, ae.id AS anomaly_id FROM noise_record r LEFT JOIN sampling_batch b ON b.id = r.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN anomaly_event ae ON ae.record_id = r.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count, MIN(sample_time) AS first_sample_time, MAX(sample_time) AS last_sample_time, ROUND(AVG(db_value), 2) AS avg_db, MAX(db_value) AS max_db, MIN(db_value) AS min_db FROM noise_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND batch_id = #{batchId}

SELECT ae.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM anomaly_event ae WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM noise_record r WHERE r.id = ae.record_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.batch_id = #{batchId}) GROUP BY ae.status
